senses.gloss:
(इ) दशि r. 1st and 10th cls. (दशति दंशयति)
1 To bite or sting.
2 To arm, to put on armour.
3 To see.
r. 10th cl. (दंशयते)
To shine.
With उप,
to be in trouble, to be reduced in circumstances.
With सम्,
to pinch, to nip, to bite.

f. (-शा) or m. plu. (-शाः)
1 The ends of a piece of cloth, the end of a garment.
2 A state, a condition, a period or time of life, as youth, age, manhood, &c.
3 The wick of a lamp.
4 The mind or faculty, of understanding.
5 Aspect or position of the planets at birth.
E.
दश to bite, to cut or divide, or be cut or divided, अङ् aff.

(इर्, उ) इरदसु r. 1st cl. (दस्यति)
1 To lose.
2 To throw or direct, to throw up or toss.
r. 10th cl. (दसयते)
To see.
(इ) दसि r. 1st and 10th cls. (दंसति दंसयति)
1 To bite or sing.
2 To see.
3 To shine.

(ऋ) दाशृ r. 1st cl. (दाशति-ते) 10th cl. (दाशयते)
To give.
5th cl. (दाश्नोति)
To hurt, to injure or kill: see दास.

m. (-शः)
1 A fisherman, the son of a Niṣada by a woman of the Ayogava caste.
2 A servant.
f. (-शी)
1 A female slave, &c.
E.
दाशृ to give, affix अच्: see दास.

(ऋ) दासृ r. 1st cl. (दासति-ते)
To give;
also दाश r. 5th cl. (दास्नोति)
To hurt, to injure, to wound or kill: this and दाश, in the last sense, are restricted by some authorities to the Vedas.

m. (-सः)
1 A fisherman.
2 A servant, a slave.
3 A Śūdra or man of the fourth tribe.
4 A Śūdra affix or appellation.
5 A person to whom it is proper to make gifts.
6 A sage, one to whom the proper nature of the soul is known.
f. (-सी)
1 A female servant or slave.
2 The wife of a slave, a fisherman or Śūdra.
3 A harlot.
4 A plant, a sort of Barleria.
E.
दास to give, affix घञ्, to whom wages, &c. are given; also दाश; otherwise, दश or दंश to bite, &c. Uṇādi affix, टन्, and the short vowel and nasal changed to आ.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Ten.
E.
कन् added to दश.

m. (-ण्ठः)
A name of RĀVAṆA.
E.
दश ten, and कण्ठ a neck; the ten-necked; also similar names, as दशग्रीव, &c.

m. (-जित्)
A name of RĀMA.
E.
दशकण्ठ RĀVAṆA, and जित् the conqueror.

m. (-रः)
RĀVAṆA: see दशकण्ठ.

n. (-नं)
The aggregate of ten vices, proceeding from the quality of desire, viz. hunting, gambling, sleeping during the day, abusiveness, lechery, drunkenness, dancing, singing, playing, and hypocrisy.
E.
दश ten, काम desire, ज born, व्यसन calamity.

adv. n. (-णं)
Ten times, ten-fold.
E.
दश, and गुण a time.

n. (-मं)
A district or collection of ten villages.
E.
दश, and ग्राम a village.

m. (-तिः)
A magistrate or chief of ten villages.
E.
दश, and ग्राम a village, पति master.

m. (-मी)
1 The head man of ten villages.
2 The municipality or corporation of the same.
E.
दशग्राम, and इनि aff.

m. (-वः)
RĀVAṆA: see दशकण्ठ.

f. (-तिः)
A hundred.

ind.
In ten ways.
E.
दश, and धाच् aff.

mfn. plu. (-श)
Ten.
E.
दश to bite, Uṇādi affix अन्, the nasal rejected.

mn. (-नः-नं)
A tooth.
m. (-नः)
The peak of a mountain.
n. (-नं)
Armour, mail.
E.
दंश to bite, affix ल्युट्.

n. (-नं)
1 Throwing, tossing.
2 Dismissing.
3 Perishing.
E.
दस to lose, affix ल्युट्.

n. (-मः)
A lip.
E.
दशन a tooth, and वामस् vesture.

m. (-शुः)
The whiteness or brightness of the teeth.
E.
दशन, and अंशु a ray.

m. (-ङ्कः)
A bite, the mark of the teeth.
E.
दशन, and अङ्क a mark.

f. (-ढ्या)
A kind of sorrel.

mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं)
Toothless.
m. (-ष्ठः)
1 Breathing, breathing out, expiration.
2 A lip.
3 Kissing, a kiss.
E.
दशन a tooth, and उच्छिष्ठ expelled, ejected.

m. (-रः)
A Buddha or Bauddha saint.
E.
दश, पारमिता a particular work or scripture of this sect, धर who has.

n. (-रं)
A fragrant grass, (Cyperus rotundus); see दाशपुर.
2 A district, part of Malva or Bundelkhand.
3 A town or city.
E.
दश for दाश a fisherman, and पुर or पूर to nourish, affix दश; also दश ten, and पुर a city: a district of ten cities.

n. (-रं)
A fragrant grass: see the preceding; also दाशपूर.

n. (-रं)
A fragrant grass, (Cyperus rotundus): see दशपुर; also दाशपूर, n. (-रं)

m. (-रं)
A fragrant grass, (Cyperus rotundus.)
E.
दास a fisherman, and पूर what nourishes, from पृ to nourish, affix क; also दाशपूर.

m. (-लः)
A Buddha or Bauddha teacher.
E.
दश ten, (the ten worlds,) बल powerful.

m. (-गः)
BUDDHA, the founder of the Bauddha sect, or a Buddha, the generic name of the sanctified teachers of that sect.
E.
दश ten, भूमि earth, and ग who goes; traversing the ten worlds; also दशभूमीश, m. (-शः) Lord of the same.

mfn. (-मः-मी-मं)
Tenth.
f. (-मी)
1 The tenth day of the half month.
2 The tenth or last stage of human life, the last ten years of a century.
E.
दशन् ten, and मट् aff.

f. (-द्या)
DURGĀ.
E.
दश ten, (forms, or names,) महा great, and विद्या a name of DURGA.

nf. (-लं-ली)
A collection of ten garlands.
E.
दश ten, माला a garland, टच् aff.

mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि)
Very old or aged.
E.
दशमी the tenth, (stage of life,) and इनि aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Very old, above ninety.
E.
दशमी, and गत arrived at.

mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं)
1 Impotent.
2 Very old, turned of ninety.
3 Dying, on the point of death.
E.
दशमी the last stage of life, and स्थ who is.

m. (खः)
A name of RĀVAṆA.
E.
दश ten, and मुख a face.

m. (-कः)
A name of RĀMA.
E.
दशमुख RĀVAṆA, and अन्तक destroyer.

n. (-लं)
A tonic medicament prepared from the roots of ten plants.
E.
दश ten, and मूल a root.

m. (-थः)
A proper name, sovereign of Ayodhya or Oude, and father of RĀMA.
E.
दश ten, and रथ a car; whose car bore him to the ten quarters of the universe.

m. (-थः)
A name of RĀMA.
E.
दशरथ the father of RĀMA, and अण् patronymic affix; also with इञ् affix दाशरथि, m. (-थिः.)

n. (-त्रं)
A period of ten days and nights.
E.
दश, and रात्र for रात्रि night.

mfn. (-भृत्)
A name of VIṢṆU.
E.
दश ten, रूप forms, (Avatars,) and भृत् who assumes.

n. (-णं)
Ten marks or attributes.
E.
दश, and लक्षण a mark.

m. (-जी)
The moon.
E.
दश ten, and वाजिन् a horse, whose car is drawn by ten horses.

n. (-तं)
A thousand.
E.
दश, and शत a hundred.

n. (-स्रं)
A myriad.
E.
दश, and सहस्र a thousand.

m. (-र्षः)
A lamp.
E.
दशा a wick, आकर्ष what possesses.

m. (-र्षी)
A lamp.
E.
दशा a wick, आङ् before, कृष to make lines, affix इनि.

m. (-नः)
The giant RĀVAṆA.
E.
दश ten, and आनन a face.

m. (-कः)
A plant, commonly Danti, (Croton polyandrum.)

n. (-लं)
Result of circumstance or of condition of life.
E.
दशा, and फल fruit.

m. (-र्णः)
A country, part of central Hindustan, lying on the south-east of the Vindhya mountains.
f. (-र्णा)
A river rising in the Vindhya hills, the Dosarene of the ancients.
E.
दश ten, ऋण a fort.

f. (-तिः)
Condition.
E.
दशा, and स्थिति stay.

m. (-र्हः)
1 A Buddha or Jina.
2 A country in the south of India, the kingdom of YADU.
m. plu. (-र्हाः)
The Yādavas or people of Daśārha.
E.
दश ten, and अर्ह proper, worthy.

mfn. (-र्हः-र्ही-र्हं)
Produced in Daśārha, (the country.)
m. (-र्हः)
A name of KṚṢṆA.
E.
दशार्ह a country or one of KṚṢṆA'S ancestors, अण् aff.

m. (-रः)
A name of VIṢṆU.
E.
दश ten, and अवतार descent; the deity of whom there are ten descents from heaven, for the purpose of protecting or punishing mankind: see अवतार.

m. (-षः)
Existing circumstances, peculiar condition.
E.
दशा, and विशेष sort.

m. (-श्वः)
A name of CANDRA or the moon.
E.
दश ten, and अश्व a horse; driving ten horses in his carriage.

m. (-स्यः)
A name of RĀVAṆA.
E.
दश ten, and आस्य face, the ten-headed.

m. (-जित्)
RĀMA.
E.
दशास्य as above, and जित् the conqueror.

n. (-हं)
A period of ten days.
E.
दश, and अहन् a day.

m. plu. (-याः)
The ten organs of sense and action, viz. the skin, eye, tongue, nose, ear, organ of speech, hand, foot, anus, and pudendum.
E.
दश ten, and इन्द्रिय an organ.

mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि)
Having ten of any thing.
m. (-शी)
The superintendent of ten villages.
E.
दश, and इनि aff.

m. (-नः)
A lamp.
E.
दशा a wick, and इन्धन fuel.

m. (-रः)
A mischievous or venomous animal, a beast of prey, &c.
E.
दश to bite, Uṇādi affix एरक्.

m. (-रः)
1 A servant.
2 A camel: see दासेर.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Born or sprung from a servant or slave.
m. (-रः)
1 A servant.
2 A fisherman.
3 A camel.
E.
दास as above, and द्रक् affix; also दाशेर, or with कन् added दासेरक.

m. (-कः)
A country destitute of water.
E.
कन् added to the preceding; also दशेरुक.

m. (-कः)
Mālva, the province.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
1 Bitten.
2 Joining to, in contact with.
E.
दश to bite, क्त aff.

mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं)
1 Lost, destroyed.
2 Thrown, tossed.
3 Sent away, dismissed.
E.
दस to lose, &c. क्त aff.

m. (-स्मः)
1 A name of fire.
2 A sacrificer, one who employs Brahmans in instituting a religious ceremony.
3 A thief.
4 A rogue, a knave.
E.
दस to throw or send, मक् Uṇādi aff.

m. (-स्युः)
An enemy.
2 A thief.
3 An oppressor, a violator, a committer of injustice, &c.
4 A barbarian, an outcaste, or a Hindu who has become so by neglect of the essential rites.
E.
दस to lose or be lost, Uṇādi affix युच्.

m. (-हः)
A name of BĀLĪ.

m. (-स्रः)
1 Either of the twin sons of AŚVINI, and physicians of Svarga; also collectively m. du. (दस्रौ).
2 An ass.
n. (-स्रं)
Thin rain, dew, frost.
E.
दस to destroy, (disease, &c.) रक Uṇādi aff.

f. (-ता)
The lunar constellation AŚVINI.
E.
दस्र a divine physician, and देवता a deity: he being the ruling genius of the asterism.

f. (-सूः)
A name of SAṂJÑĀ, a wife of the sun, and mother, according to one legend, of the twin physicians of INDRA'S heaven.
E.
दस्र as above, and सू mother.

f. (-नी)
The mother of VYĀSA: see दासनन्दिनी.

f. (-नी)
A name of SATYAVATĪ, the mother of the poet VYĀSA.
E.
दास a fisherman, and नन्दिनी daughter; also दाशनन्दिनी.

m. (-यः)
A servant.
f. (-यी)
The mother of VYĀSA: see दासेय.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Born of a slave, &c.
m. (-यः)
1 A servant or slave.
2 A fisherman.
f. (-यी)
The mother of VYĀSA.
E.
दास as above, affix ढक्; also दाशेय.

mfn. (-श्वः-श्वा-श्वं)
Liberal, giving, a donor, a giver.
E.
दाश to give, व aff.

mfn. (-श्वन्-श्वती-श्वत्)
Liberal, munificent.
E.
दा to give, श्वत् aff.

n. (-त्वं)
Slavery, servitude.
E.
दास, and त्व affix; also with तल् affix, दासता.

f. (-सी)
The female slave of a slave.
E.
दास, and दास the female.

f. (-का)
A female servant or slave.
E.
कन् added to दामी.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Thrown, lost.
2 Lost, destroyed.
E.
दस to toss, affix क्त, इट् inserted, and the vowel made long.

m. (-त्त्रः)
1 The son of a slave.
2 A bastard.
E.
दासी a female slave, and पुत्त्र a son.

n. (-भं)
A multitude of female slaves.
E.
दासी a female slave, and सभा an assembly.

n. (-स्य)
Slavery, servitude.
E.
दास a slave, affix ष्यञ्.
